slug: 2026-01-01 Burundi's growing social protection system now runs on openIMIS

facts.fact: openIMIS states that since May 2025 the CORE-MIS solution powered by openIMIS has managed cash transfers and income-generating-activity financing for 1.25 million Merankabandi beneficiaries across five provinces, after over 1 million records were migrated from the legacy system.
openIMIS states that Burundi's multiple payment providers are integrated with the Merankabandi system for automated payments and reconciliation.

systems.owner: Government of Burundi, World Bank-financed Merankabandi
